# External third-party reviews

Formal third-party reviews of LTP — primarily whitepaper and
mathematical reviews. Vendor audits of code live in the per-surface
folders (`python-sdk/`, `contracts/`, `corridor-wire/`); this folder
is for reviews of designs, papers, and proofs.
